# Installed dependency notices

`runtime-license-inventory.json` and `RUNTIME-NOTICES.txt` are generated by:

```sh
node scripts/multica-license-audit.mjs
```

The audit follows installed desktop/sidecar production dependencies, installed peers and platform optionals, starting from the actual package manifests. It records396 installed package versions,32 direct references, resolved versions, declared licenses, installed byte counts and SHA-256 hashes of packaged LICENSE/NOTICE or README license sections. The bundle retains the observed upstream wording, normalizing line endings/trailing whitespace and indenting notices for packaging; inventory hashes refer to the original installed texts. It is not a new license for Socrates and does not claim that every installed package is shipped in every build.

Nine installed packages have no available notice section: two versions of `@ai-sdk/provider-utils`, `@cfworker/json-schema`, `@napi-rs/keyring-darwin-arm64`, `buffers`, `chainsaw`, `js-tiktoken`, `langsmith` and `saxes`. `buffers@0.1.1` also lacks license metadata. Exact versions and uninstalled platform-optional dependencies are listed in the inventory. Metadata alone is not a substitute for a missing notice; obtain matching upstream notices/permissions before distribution. No guessed attribution has been inserted.

Socrates currently has no root distribution LICENSE. This source-preview audit does not cover Rust binary redistribution, absent platform packages or signed installers. Existing `DeepSeek-Harness-LICENSE` and the sidecar's models-dev fixture license remain separate and unchanged. There are no added M07 dependencies or lockfile changes.

Multica is a behavioral reference under its custom license, including Part I restrictions. No Multica code, UI, icons, branding or assets were imported. Current source comparison, reuse decisions and verification boundaries are in [M07 acceptance](../doc/multica-m07-acceptance.md#reuse-and-license-audit).
